source.title: Lurgan Mail, 23 May 1958, p. 11 ("Council Members Get Their Seats Without Contest")
source.publisher: Lurgan Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: 'The seven outgoing members of Moira Council returned unopposed are Messrs. A. Gilpin (chairman), T. C. Stevenson, J. C. G. McQuoid, R. Malcomson, G. McCartney, C. J. Phillips, J. Wilson' (page image read)

note: Triennial election of Moira Rural District Council, 1958 (Co. Down county and rural poll day Thursday 5 June 1958). Seven candidates were nominated for the seven seats, all outgoing members, so there was no contest (Lurgan Mail, 23 May 1958, p. 11). No party labels were printed. Returned unopposed. The report names the seven members without their divisions; the division is the one he was returned for in 1955 (Lurgan Mail, 20 May 1955, p. 1) and held again in 1961 (inferred).
